headline: Nevish Line Fighting Rises as Expanse Colours Shift Again
war_summary: The Nevish Line remains the war's most turbulent sector — six Warden works, one Colonial and one unclaimed — and the tempo there has risen rather than eased: sixty-nine actions in the past day, twenty of them within two hours, with Princefal, Blackcoat Way, Grief Mother, Blinding Stones and Tomb Father all touched. Weathered Expanse has shifted again; the sector now reads four Colonial works, two Warden and three unclaimed, one position having passed to Colonial colours since the last edition, after fifty-one actions in the day about Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance. Marban Hollow holds at four Warden, three Colonial and one unclaimed through twenty-eight actions, though its guns have fallen quiet in the past six hours. Kuura Strand's tangle at Faden Point persists, twenty-eight actions in the day, the latest logged as this edition closed. Linn Mercy stands nine Colonial, one Warden and one unclaimed, its day's toll running above three thousand Colonial and four thousand Warden. The Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle continue to bleed heavily without a change of colours.
